IS 10965 : 1984 Specification for Valves for Aircraft Tyre TubesUDC 629.13 : 629.11.012.556.1TED 14Reaffirmed 20211 ScopePrescribes the dimensions, materials, tests and acceptancecriteria for valves for tyre tubes for applications with innertubes for use in aircraft. For the purposes of, clarity, thesevalves shall be called 'aerovalves' to identify them from valvesfor automobile tyre tubes. Valve cores and caps are coveredseparately.
